Choosing a dataset resets the other controls to that dataset's own configuration. Visible rows sets the scroll window; blank shows all. Total rows sets how many data rows the dataset renders (samples are cycled to fill; capped at 500; blank keeps the dataset's natural count). Column priorities hide middle columns as the frame narrows; full bleed applies at container widths under 640px.
